text:
Maya: heads-up — NimbleAI wants to list their Cascade-13B model on our marketplace and include a hardware bundle with AtlasEdge GPUs from HWCo. they also want a Systems Integrator (SI) to offer turnkey deployment.
Cole: do we have their license + CLA? distribution + SI bundling changes obligations. need to check if they allow redistribution or only hosting.
Maya: attached in email: short clause says "permit distribution to customers and partners for commercial use" — no explicit no-relicensing.
Priya: security check: request training-data provenance + third-party data vendor list. SI bundling raises supply-chain questions.
Marco: ops question — hardware bundle means we may need custom AMIs and pilot images. what's their expectation for hosting raw checkpoints vs inference-only container?
Maya: NimbleAI prefers us to host quantized runtime images publicly and allow SI partners to host full precision weights on-prem under a reseller agreement.
Cole: reseller-hosted weights vs redist from our site is different. if SIs host, we still need indemnities and a clear chain-of-custody. ask for SI partner contract template.
Lauren: marketing wants co-branded launch but needs legal + security sign-off. also want a 3-week runway for joint PR assets.
distro-bot: reminder: create PART-950 and upload license + data summary for review: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PART-950
Priya: add request for security attestation from both NimbleAI and the SI: pentest summary, dependency SBOM, and SOC2 or equivalent.
Marco: if SI will host weights, ops needs a fingerprinted checksum and a periodic audit hook. otherwise we refuse to list downloadable artifacts on our CDN.
Maya: NimbleAI says SI is "IntegrateNow"; they provided a CRO-friendly draft. I'll ask for their reseller agreement and IntegrateNow's SOC2 report.
Cole: also ask NimbleAI to add an attribution clause and prohibit sublicensing to other marketplace vendors. we should require a CLA that preserves attribution and prevents re-licensing.
Lauren: question for product — do we allow a marketplace SKU that is "Model + HW bundle (partner-hosted weights)"? need product ops sign-off on billing and support boundaries.
Marco: technically doable. we'll tag support as "partner-supported" and surface a clear SLA in the listing. need ~5 days to wire the SKU and access controls after docs are cleared.
Maya: action items: Maya will collect license, SI contract, SOC2; Cole drafts an addendum (attribution + no-sublicense + indemnity); Priya lists security attestations; Marco scopes infra & SKU; Lauren drafts PR timeline. reconvene next Mon.
Cole: I'll also draft a short EULA overlay that limits distribution via SI partners and requires reseller flow documentation.
Maya: updating PART-950 now. thanks everyone.
